get_viewer_passive: get a MuJoCo passive viewer by calling get_viewer with show_viewer True and a model and data
get_viewer_dummy: get a DummyViewer context manager by calling get_viewer with show_viewer False for headless simulation
launch_passive_viewer: launch a MuJoCo passive viewer using the lambda returned by get_viewer with show_viewer set to True
use_dummy_viewer_context: use the DummyViewer context manager from get_viewer to simulate without a graphical viewer in headless mode
check_viewer_is_running: check if the viewer is running by calling the is_running method on the DummyViewer object
